references.text: Proverbs speaks about humility and pride, which is closely linked to the message in Matthew 23:12.
Luke repeats the message from Matthew regarding humility and exaltation.
Luke again emphasizes the importance of humility to be exalted.
Revelation speaks about correction and humility leading to exaltation, parallel to Matthew 23:12.
The book of Psalms highlights God's relationship with the humble and the proud, in line with the theme in Matthew 23:12.
Isaiah speaks about God dwelling with the humble, which resonates with the message on humility in Matthew 23:12.
